# Paths the base autofix never writes (shell globs, repository-relative; a
# "!" line exempts a path from every freeze): the
# permanent freezes and the settings slot. A regenerated file under one is
# reported and left to its owner's pull request (Package.swift: the app FFI pin
# goes through app-ffi-release.yml's app-ffi-repin pull request).
cmux.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj
Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Package.swift
schemas/settings/*
Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextSettings/*
webviews/src/pages/settings/*
docs/mdm/*
# Pure generator output of the settings export tests (regenerate-settings-exports.sh on a
# Mac; SettingsSchemaExportTests compares them with a fresh export): the bot
# copies them in (hq-11, 2026-10-16). The settings sources stay frozen.
!schemas/settings/settings-schema.json
!docs/mdm/com.manaflow.cmux*
!docs/mdm/cmux-example.mobileconfig
!docs/mdm/managed-preferences.md
# The bot pushes with GITHUB_TOKEN, which cannot push workflow files.
